历史 227 failed verification evidence 与 227 terminal result 必须保持不可改写；新的 Verification authority 必须是新增的 point-in-time authority，不得伪造或覆盖历史失败事实。
在 completed Apply 且当前 Change Verification failed、candidate bytes 未变化时，提供最小 exact-candidate re-verification 机制，允许产生新的正式 Verification authority。

findings.title: Selected tests do not physically exercise the new `flowkit verify --retry` CLI write surface
findings.problem: 228/229 approved Proposal freezes `flowkit verify --retry` as the only explicit re-verification write surface for completed Apply + failed Verification. 230 implements routing in src/cli/main.ts and src/cli/change-action.ts and thoroughly tests the underlying retry service/publication/Reader logic, but no selected CLI/G1 regression invokes `verify --retry`; only bare `flowkit verify` is exercised.
findings.contractRef: 228 approved Proposal explicit `flowkit verify --retry`; flowkit-change-cli-end-to-end-and-performance explicit retry scenarios; tasks 7.5; Flowkit Explore Skill v2 Verification Closure
findings.invariant: A changed user-facing CLI behavior must be reached by a physical test selected by formal Verification; logical `tests-cli` selection is insufficient when no executed target invokes the changed route.
findings.requiredOutcome: Add a regression inside the approved mutation surface that invokes the actual `flowkit verify --retry` CLI path against completed Apply + failed Verification + exact unchanged candidate, proving it publishes the superseding authority/history without allocating a Run. Breaking the route back to bare verify must make selected CLI verification fail.
acceptance: A physical test selected by tests-cli invokes `flowkit verify --retry` through the actual CLI routing surface, not only retryFailedChangeVerification() directly.
It proves retry publishes new authority, preserves predecessor fingerprint-addressed history, and allocates no Formal Action/Run/NNN; bare verify remains read-only.
Routing --retry to bare projectChangeVerification makes the selected CLI regression fail.
Fix remains within the approved 29-selector apply/revise-apply surface or fails closed.
